verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say you can access 401(k) plans and manage them from the payroll account. They also cover setting up and calculating deductions from each paycheck. That covers offering a retirement plan, but nothing explicitly states that contributions sync automatically with each payroll run, and the asterisks on the 401(k) claim suggest it may be a partner add-on. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll 401(k) contribution sync, details of the plan provider or integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
